personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A tunnel drawn column by column and a flight model are new code in a renderer that runs every frame; the design keeps it inside the kart and pins the rules with tests, but I want the frame's cost held, not hoped for.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: A tunnel, spectator ships and jumps in the arcade are more polish on what I already see as a gimmick; at least nothing touches the database.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Six asks from one message, kept as one PRD: a station to drive through, jumps, pads, shortcuts and a fairer edge make the race worth another lap.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: It stays in arcade/kart and keeps the race pure and seeded; the shortcut gates change the lap rule, so I want a test that a lap still needs every waypoint unless a gate credits it.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Falling less on a grazed edge is the fix players feel first; the rest is visible on the first lap.

objection.text: I already see the tool as a gimmick and avoid using it. A PRD that adds a tunnel, spectator ships and jumps to a mini-game confirms to me that it is fluff.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: The spec holds the tunnel to the floor's 600 samples a column at every waypoint and inside the tunnel, on both grids, and checks the handheld grid in a browser: that is the guard I wanted.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Still a mini-game PRD; it touches no data and rolls back with one revert, which is the most I can ask of it.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Twenty-four criteria a player can check on one lap, with the jump distances worked out before a line is written.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: The gates credit two waypoints only when the first is the next to pass, a lap off the main line elsewhere gets nothing, and the rivals' no-fall seeds are kept: the lap rule stays tested.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Half a second of grace is a small number with a big effect on how fair the race feels.
